name: 16407 · Corry, PA
findings: ZIP 16407 (Corry) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16407 (Corry) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16407 (Corry) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).
